test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In April 2021 the Union Education Minister launched the world's first microsensor-based explosive trace detector called 'NanoSniffer'. NanoSniffer was developed by which IIT incubated startup?
solution:
The Correct Answer is **__IIT-Bombay.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​"NanoSniffer" **was introduced on **April 9, 2021, by Union Education Minister Ramesh Pokhriyal, or "Nishank."**
 
• **India** used a **NanoSniffer micro-electromechanical system (MEMS) **to create the first micro-sensor-based** explosive trace detector (ETD)** in the world.
 
• The **IIT Bombay startup NanoSniff Technologies** created **Nanosniffer**, while Vehant Technologies, a spin-off of the **IIT Delhi** **startup Kritikal Solutions,** is responsible for marketing it.
 
• It accurately identifies a variety of military, commercial, and homemade explosives threats and offers visible and auditory alerts with a sunlight-readable colour display. **NanoSniffer** offers trace detection of the **nano-gram level **of explosives in less than 10 seconds.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **NanoSniffer**

 
 
• **​High Energy Materials Research Laboratory (HEMRL)** testing conducted by the **DRDO in Pune** found **Nanosniffer** to be successful.
 
• The nation's top counterterrorism unit, the **National Security Guard, has also tested Nanosniffer (NSG).**
 
• The development of **NanoSniffer** is a step towards **Atmanirbhar Bharat, Prime Minister Narendra Modi's goal for an independent India.**
 
 

1d
